# Workflow implementation

For shared ownership/adoption policy, start at README.md; then read only the
selected stage, standard or docs/provenance.md. Projects should use the thin
AGENTS.md pointer recipe in README.md and pin this repository at
external/research-workflows.
Agents own scoped branches/worktrees, commits and reviewable PRs; merge only
small validated changes within the user's standing authorization. Pause for
major or destructive changes, and preserve uncommitted or unmerged scientific
work. After merge, clean up only the agent's own temporary branch/worktree and
retain required receipts or artifacts.
Accept explicit project/campaign/run identities. Resolve private sites and
physical environments through Fleet; never track endpoints, usernames, identity
paths, storage roots or secrets. Do not submit compute or publish scientific
results from preparation or transport commands.

Freeze changed inputs/settings into a new date-first ISO run using New York
calendar dates, explicit timestamp offsets and parent links. Update project pins
deliberately. Preserve frozen inputs, previous results and submission receipts.
Keep progress and transport observations separate from scientific evidence.

An exact sequence needs a native source record, file hash and run identity.
Register mutations or fusions as new candidates with parent links; do not replace
the parent or infer missing generation details. Preserve construct/topology,
chemistry and coordinate identity. Observations need an exact source locator,
method/version and scientific scope. Freeze the ranked cross-campaign selection
and rationale; require researcher review, eligibility and track-limit checks.

Avoid new symlinks and duplicate engine/model installations. Audit consumers
before moving environments or scientific paths; ask at disruptive boundaries.

For generic requests, read docs/defaults.md. Explicit user and project
specifications win. For remote execution boundaries and evidence states, follow
[docs/execution-contract.md](docs/execution-contract.md). The project adapter
owns launch and monitoring behavior under that contract; use Fleet only to
resolve machine inventory and SSH/Tailscale access.
